allow: PowerShell($ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; foreach \($p in '/openapi.json','/swagger.json','/docs-json','/api-json','/api/docs-json'\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "OK $p \($\($r.StatusCode\), len=$\($r.Content.Length\)\)"; break } catch { "FAIL $p $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell(try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/docs-json" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content } catch { Write-Output "ERR1: $_"; try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/docs" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content } catch { Write-Output "ERR2: $_" } })
